simple.meaning: פֶּרֶק (pereq) is a Hebrew word meaning “rapine ; also a fork (in roads).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פֶּרֶק (H6563) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Obadiah 1:14, with occurrences in Obadiah, Nahum.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֶּרֶק (H6563) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פֶּרֶק (H6563) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פֶּרֶק (pereq) / H6563 is traced through Obadiah 1:14, Nahum 3:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
